WPSB No.561 of 2015
Hon ' b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J
Hon 'b le Ash ish Nait h an i, J.
None present for the petitioner.
2. Mr. S.K. Nainwal, learned Standing Counsel,
for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Petitioner was appointed as Law Officer in
Uttarakhand Mandi Parishad vide order dated
31.10.2006 passed by the Director Mandi.
Subsequently, he was appointed as "Sahayak Nagar
Adhikari" in Nagar Nigam, Dehradun on deputation
for a period of one year vide order dated
07.11.2015. Petitioner has challenged the said order
of deputation by contending that he should have
been appointed as Executive Officer, which is a
superior post.
4. Since no one can be sent on deputation from
one organization to another without his consent,
therefore, petitioner could have refused to go on
deputation on the post of "Sahayak Nagar Adhikari".
Thus, the challenge thrown by the petitioner to the
order dated 07.11.2015 does not appear to be
sustainable. Even otherwise also, the term for which
petitioner was sent on deputation is over long back,

therefore, no useful purpose would be served by
keeping this writ petition pending.
5. Writ petition is accordingly dism issed.
( Ash ish Nait h an i, J) ( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J)
